newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philex Gold H1 net 118.5 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Philex Gold H1 net 118.5 mln pesos.

text.p: Philex Gold Inc made a net income of 118.5 million pesos in the first half of the year, its parent firm said on Wednesday.
Of the total profits of Philex Gold, some 96.8 million pesos was booked by Philex Mining Corp as equity income, Philex Mining chairman Gerard Brimo told Reuters.
Philex Mining owns 81.8 percent of Philex Gold.
Brimo said the output of Philex Gold's Bulawan mine in Negros Occidental in the central Philippines in the first half of the year increased by 70 percent to 68,820 ounces.
The Sibutad mine in southern Zamboanga del Norte added 1,992 ounces of gold in the second quarter of the year.
Brimo said about 67,000 ounces of Philex gold's production in 1997 has been locked in at a price of $352 per ounce while 64,000 ounces of 1998 production has been fixed at $348 per ounce.
